verdict.rationale: Ente Auth syncs TOTP/HOTP 2FA codes across mobile, desktop and web, but nothing in the evidence shows it storing or syncing user passkeys. The only passkey mention concerns Ente's own account login, which is an adjacent feature and not cross-ecosystem passkey sync. Code sync is a different capability and does not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As a power user, my passkeys sync across ecosystems — iOS, Android, Windows, Linux, browsers — instead of being locked to one platform vendor
